subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should Control UI `/stop` for a selected non-global channel session permanently mean “abort the active run and discard that session’s queued successors” via the new opt-in `clearQueued` Gateway policy?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately backward-compatible for existing RPC and SDK callers, but it creates a new public cancellation semantic for an interactive UI command; code review cannot determine whether queued follow-up work should be retained or discarded by product policy.

options.title: Adopt selected-session queue discard
options.body: Approve the opt-in `clearQueued` policy for Control UI selected non-global sessions, preserving the current compatibility behavior for all callers that omit the field.

options.title: Abort only the active run
options.body: Keep selected-session targeting but remove the UI `clearQueued` opt-in so queued work can continue after the active run is stopped.

recommendation.title: Adopt selected-session queue discard
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in `clearQueued` policy for Control UI selected non-global sessions, preserving the current compatibility behavior for all callers that omit the field.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review context identifies this contributor as the most directly connected person to the selected-session stop design; final policy acceptance still belongs to the repository’s Gateway and Control UI owners.
